trust_decision.summary: Which Java methods an API-owner-supplied VTL template may call is decided only by Velocity's introspector set at VelocityEngine construction. At the pinned commit both engines leave Velocity's default UberspectImpl in place, which allows any reflective call (getClass().forName...), with no loop, output or time limits.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'API Gateway VTL Mapping Templates'. VtlTemplateEngine is the only API Gateway class that builds a VelocityEngine and calls evaluate.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report names API Gateway mapping templates. AppSync is a different service whose GraphQL engine moved to a sidecar, and nothing in production calls AppSyncVtlEngine in-process, so a solver can call it dead code. Separately, a solver who edits only the shadowed velocity.properties (it already holds a restrict list) can argue the engines pick it up by default.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Ordinary mapping templates must keep working: public methods on $input/$util/$context ($input.json, $input.path, $util.escapeJavaScript, #set($context.responseOverride.status)), #foreach over lists, and getClass().getName(), which the fix's tests keep allowed. Too broad a fix breaks these, e.g. blocking all method calls, removing #foreach, failing the template at the loop cap instead of truncating, or blocking java.util maps.

O6_input_shapes: reflective escape starting from any context object ($util, $input, $context map, $stageVariables) via getClass()
Class.forName with different target class names (System, Runtime, ProcessBuilder)
#set string doubling inside a short loop (output cap throws)
a long-running loop body (wall-clock deadline checked per iteration)

O7_producer.where: src/main/resources/org/apache/velocity/runtime/defaults/velocity.properties:201 (Velocity's default-properties resource selects the uberspector; restrict lists at :219-243 are inert under UberspectImpl)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a separate VelocityEngine built locally for WebSocket/HTTP API templates without the sandbox, instead of the injected shared engine
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The AppSync engine is already a separate copy with its own init (AppSyncVtlEngine.java:21-33), and v2 lives in another package, so a maintainer copying the engine setup there is plausible.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a public getter on a context helper that exposes a raw ObjectMapper or service object, which the class denylist does not cover (how-type: denylist misses an equivalent object)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Util helpers already hold ObjectMapper privately (AppSyncUtil.java:12, VtlTemplateEngine.java:350). Exposing it for a 'toJson with options' helper is a natural feature addition.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a file resource loader added for #parse/#include of shared templates, reachable from template text
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: FileResourceLoader is already registered for reflection (VtlTemplateEngine.java:53), so enabling it is a one-line change a maintainer could make.

O9_family: code/template injection (server-side template injection via unrestricted Velocity introspection), CWE-94

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Change introspector.uberspect.class in the shadowed velocity.properties to SecureUberspector (or set it only on VtlTemplateEngine). Per fix.diff:1065-1077 the properties file may not be the copy loaded under Quarkus, and AppSyncVtlEngine stays open.
